items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I clapped it for Roosevelt, man. Fred Roosevelt. Oh. When they built the mall. Oh, get this kick, man. It blows fucking up in an open car with Governor Lash and Mayor May Street.

ctx.x: They say they made a movie out there once, but I never heard about it. I saw something with the camera. I don't know what that happened to the movies. Were you in it? Yeah. You were in the movie, huh?

I clapped it for Roosevelt, man. Fred Roosevelt. Oh. When they built the mall. Oh, get this kick, man. It blows fucking up in an open car with Governor Lash and Mayor May Street. This stupid band leader, Italian, starts playing the Mussolini march. I swear. I don't know how much of they was in the band. And here's how it goes. Da-da-da-da-da-da. Da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da. Da-da-da-da-da-da-da. Da-da-da-da-da-da-da. Da-da-da-da-da-da-da. Da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da. Da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da. Da-da-da-da-da-da-da. And Leo…
How long did you stay in Chicago?
